title: QUIC RFC 9000 NEW_TOKEN Replay Enforcement Work Item
summary: Implement and prove listener-local NEW_TOKEN one-time acceptance by recording consumed valid tokens and rejecting later attempts that reuse the same token value.
planned_changes:
- Add a listener-scoped consumed-token replay cache keyed by token fingerprint.
- Expose token expiration parsing from the NEW_TOKEN envelope helper for replay-cache eviction.
- Route valid listener NEW_TOKEN admission through the replay cache before marking the peer address as validated.
- Add focused requirement-home proof that the first valid token use is admitted and a second connection attempt using the same token is rejected as replayed.
- Update canonical trace artifacts for the S8P1P4 replay requirements.
verification_plan: Run a Release build, the focused S8P1P4 replay requirement-home filter, SpecTrace JSON validation, and the smallest relevant no-build test scope.
out_of_scope: Persistent token replay state across listener or process restarts.
Retry token source-address and source-port binding.
completion_notes: Completed as listener-local NEW_TOKEN one-time acceptance and replay rejection. Broader persistence and public policy remain separate follow-ons.
